query:
ALTER TABLE strategies 
  ADD COLUMN currentStage int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  ADD COLUMN stage1Tasks json NULL,
  ADD COLUMN stage2Tasks json NULL,
  ADD COLUMN stage3Tasks json NULL,
  ADD COLUMN claimStatus varchar(32) DEFAULT 'not_started';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documentUploads (
  id int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  userId int NOT NULL,
  policyId int NULL,
  strategyId int NULL,
  taskId varchar(128) NULL,
  category varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  fileName varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  fileUrl text NOT NULL,
  fileKey varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  mimeType varchar(128) NULL,
  fileSize int NULL,
  createdAt timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now())
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS userContacts (
  id int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  userId int NOT NULL,
  name varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  email varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  relationship varchar(128) NULL,
  receiveCcEmails int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  updatedAt timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
